description: Full-text search with filtering, sorting, and saved search support.

screens_added.name: Search Results
screens_added.purpose: Results list with filter and sort controls

screens_added.name: Filter Panel
screens_added.purpose: Advanced filter options — slides up from bottom

flows_added: Tap search bar → type query → live results → tap result
Search results → open filter panel → apply filters → refined results
Save search → get notified when new results match
interaction_patterns: Live search — results update as user types, no submit needed
Recent searches shown on empty state — tap to re-run
Filter panel slides up from bottom as sheet
Active filter chips shown below search bar — tap to remove
Result count updates in real time as filters change
Clear all filters — single tap resets to unfiltered results

error_flows.ui: Illustration of empty search. Query shown in message: 'No results for "[query]"'. Suggestions: check spelling, try fewer words, browse categories. Show 3–5 related or trending searches. Never show empty white screen.
Message: 'Search is taking too long — please try again'. Retry button. If repeated failure: 'Search is temporarily unavailable'. Show browse categories as fallback. Never show spinner indefinitely.

Show count updating in real time as filters are applied. When count reaches zero: warn before applying: 'No results match all these filters'. Highlight which filter is most restrictive. Suggest removing one filter.

error_flows.trigger: Saved search no longer returns results
error_flows.ui: In saved searches: amber badge 'No current results'. Last result count and date shown. 'Update filters' CTA. Do not delete saved search automatically — user may want to keep for future.

error_flows.trigger: Search index temporarily out of sync
error_flows.ui: Show results with note: 'Results may not include the most recent updates'. Timestamp of last index shown. Never show stale data without disclosure.

edge_cases.case: Search query contains special characters or SQL-like strings
edge_cases.ui: Sanitize silently — never show error for user input. Treat as plain text search. Never expose that sanitization occurred.

edge_cases.case: User applies contradictory filters (e.g. price min > price max)
edge_cases.ui: Auto-correct: swap min and max silently. Or: show inline warning on the contradicting field. Never allow search to run with logically impossible filter combination.
Accept and search. Truncate display in search bar to last 60 characters with '...' prefix. Full query used for search. Never silently truncate the actual search.

edge_cases.case: User searches immediately after first app open (cold start)
edge_cases.ui: Search index may not be warm. Show 'Searching...' with skeleton results for up to 2 seconds before showing empty state. Never flash empty state before results have had time to load.

edge_cases.case: Filter options change after user has saved a filter set
edge_cases.ui: On loading saved filter: check each filter option still exists. Silently drop invalid options. Show notice: 'Some saved filters are no longer available and have been removed'.

edge_cases.case: Search with accented characters or non-Latin scripts
edge_cases.ui: Normalize search input — 'café' matches 'cafe'. Support right-to-left display for Arabic/Hebrew queries. Results sort correctly regardless of script.
